newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil declines comment on $750 mln bond talk.
newsitem.headline: Brazil declines comment on $750 mln bond talk.

text.p: The Brazilian Central Bank Thursday declined to comment on market talk in London it planned to issue a $750 million global bond next week.
"It's a no comment," said a Central Bank spokesman.
Traders said a five- or 10-year maturity was likely and a mandate was due to be awarded in the next few days.

Brazil has been rumoured for some time to be considering a Brady buyback or debt swap deal after winning Senate permission. But syndicate managers said there was no specific link between the potential global bond and such an operation.
